component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.signature.listener
component.documentation: The signature listener, synchronous, in the transaction of the change that fires it: sends a signature request's file when the request is created, by someone who may write its record; marks the record out for signature; lets the requester or an administrator cancel it while it is out; and refuses every other change to a request, any change to a record's sgn: properties but the server's, a change to the file out for signature, and the deletion or trash of a request, or of a record while it is out. No Automation operation: a person reaches it by creating a request, as every client does, through the REST API or a workflow's chain. Every refusal marks the transaction for rollback.
